plugins.description: Pins a small pixel-art slot machine in a neon cyberpunk style to the bottom-right of the screen, above the prompt: pull the trigger on every prompt, the reels keep turning while Claude works, and you might win a FEATURE, a CLIENT, or a LIFE.
